# Design task: composer-interface

Branch: design/composer-interface. PR target: build/composer. Status: not started. Create from the current build tip when assigned.

Dependencies: G1 interfaces; actual comparison/backend path required for acceptance. Requirements: R04, R07, R08, R11, R17.

Objective: one real source-review/composition journey with three distinct presets, genuinely new custom profiles and accessible per-block evidence.

Ownership: UI, scoped style/presets and block authoring controls. Assign paths before edits and use the real request service/saved results. No framework replacement, new scientific status semantics or duplicate audience-QMD engine solely for visual parity. A visual fixture may be prepared earlier but is not completed integration.

Acceptance: add/remove/duplicate/reorder/configure, disclosure defaults, UI/CLI effective settings, restored presets, attribution of editorial content, safe failure, responsive/keyboard behavior and actual permitted inspector downloads. Keep required context and actual export restrictions.

Handoff: G4 live end-to-end candidate with screenshots, interaction findings and human feedback. Record scientific versus visual review separately. Follow [handoff](../HANDOFF.md), [ledger](../requirements.json) and [review](../REVIEW_AND_RESUME.md).
